sources: Original Sleeper get_roster Week15 named manager rosters
method: Each case joins a completed historical trade's received-player IDs to a recorded Week15 starting roster and a final paired team matchup. Raw acquired-player points are presented against actual final matchup result; no no-trade lineup or substitution is assumed.
limitations: A Week15 final paired matchup is verified; specific playoff-bracket stage/status is not asserted without its bracket metadata.
Scoring by players acquired in a trade is not the incremental contribution caused by that trade. Results must not be reclassified as trade wins/losses.
Data only includes these four cases, not all 2020–25 completed trades, and excludes unfinished 2026 Week10.
An acquired asset appearing on an owner's starting roster does not establish that they would have used the same lineup without the original transaction.
Postseason 2021 Week17 and several other weeks have unpaired or unpublished matchup records; no result inferred for those.

cases.weekContext: Week 15 of 2025; next week Stilly beat JMid 126.76–100.46
cases.narrative: Stilly won a verified 122.12–122.00 paired Week 15 matchup against Kuhl while acquired players St. Brown and Goff contributed 61.42 starting points. The result establishes actual participation, not a counterfactual win caused by the trade.

cases.weekContext: 2021 Week 15; recorded loss despite two acquired starters totaling 42.50
cases.narrative: Birch's acquired Andrews and Jacobs started for 42.50 points, but the team lost the final recorded Week 15 pairing 96.28–109.02. This is a strong production case, not a trade-created win.

cases.weekContext: Birch lost the 2023 Week15 paired matchup despite starting Lamb
cases.narrative: Birch started Lamb for 15.10 points in a Week 15 loss to Stilly, 105.06–146.36. Lamb later had 23.20 and 34.70 observed points in Weeks 16 and 17, but later bracket meaning has not been assigned.

cases.weekContext: Two participants from the November 2023 three-manager trade met in Week 15
cases.narrative: Thommy beat Stew in their recorded Week 15 pairing, 128.42–72.14. Three players received by Thommy in the recovered nine-player, three-manager trade started and produced 40.20 points combined. The margin and players are verified, but the result is not a causal trade rating.
